sloka: प्रहिताः कपि राजेन देवैः अपि दुरासदाः ।राम लक्ष्मण बाणाः च निशिताः कंक पत्रिणः ॥४-५९-२६॥
transliteration: prahitāḥ kapi rājena devaiḥ api durāsadāḥ ।rāma lakṣmaṇa bāṇāḥ ca niśitāḥ kaṁka patriṇaḥ ॥4-59-26॥

translations.english: 'The heronfeathered arrows of Rama and Lakshmana are sharp and strong enough to protect or subdue all the three worlds.
